extDescription.message: Select any area of a page and translate the text in it instantly, like a temporary screenshot. Runs entirely on your computer.

hintSelect.message: Drag to select what to translate

noText.message: No text found in this area

noTranslator.message: Chrome's built-in translator isn't available here. It needs Chrome 138 or newer on desktop.

unsupportedPair.message: Chrome can't translate from {src} to {dst} yet.

ocrMissing.message: The OCR files are missing from the extension. See the README.

restricted.message: Chrome doesn't allow extensions on this page.

optOcr.message: Languages of the text in images

optOcrHint.message: Tick only the ones you usually read. The more languages, the slower the reading.

optShortcutHint.message: Alt+Shift+T. To change it, open chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

optPrivacy.message: Everything happens on your computer: capturing, reading and translating. Nothing is sent to any server.

langJpnVertHint.message: For vertical text. Select just the text inside the speech bubble, without its outline.

romajiKept.message: Romaji (Japanese in Latin letters) is left as is

noTextHint.message: No text found. If it's Japanese, Chinese or Korean, tick that language in the options.

optLauncherHint.message: A shortcut to start Psittacus without the toolbar icon or Alt+Shift+T.

launcherCorner.message: In a corner of the window

optLauncherPerm.message: Chrome will ask for access to the sites you visit, only to show the button. Nothing is read or captured until you click it. Already open tabs need a reload.

permDenied.message: Without the permission the button can’t be shown.
